themes.title: Crypto falls with tech stocks
themes.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation and rising Treasury yields hit risk assets; it is down about 8% in November (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Bitcoin below its 50-week average
themes.summary: BTC fell below its 50-week moving average near $75,153, reversing a September breakout that some analysts had read as the start of a new rally (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Stronger dollar and Fed hike expectations
themes.summary: The U.S. Dollar Index briefly topped 103, its highest since March 2025, and markets have largely priced in a December Fed rate increase (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Fifth straight day of ETF outflows
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $300 million on Wednesday, nearly $270 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and ether ETFs lost about $145 million (The Crypto Desk, citing SoSoValue).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinking
themes.summary: Glassnode data show stablecoin supply fell about $14.2 billion in the 30 days to Nov. 9, the fastest contraction since June 2022 (The Crypto Desk).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin fell about 3.9% and Ether about 4.2% over 24 hours as of midday ET (Cryptonro).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Solana fell about 5.1%, XRP 5.1%, BNB 4.9%, Dogecoin 5.4% and Cardano 5.5% over 24 hours (Cryptonro).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: Arbitrum fell about 9.6%, Ethena 9.5% and Aave 8.5% over the 24 hours to 11:05 a.m. ET; 76 of the top 90 coins declined (TokenPost).

categories.name: Crypto-linked stocks
categories.note: Strategy (MSTR) fell as much as 6% after MSCI said it will remove the company from its indexes (Yahoo Finance).

watch_list.why: The October PPI report is due Friday at 8:30 AM ET and could shape expectations for the Fed's December decision (The Crypto Desk; CoinDesk).
Wintermute says $68,000 is the next level down it is watching and that reclaiming $80,000 would change its cautious view (CoinDesk).

watch_list.topic: FOMC minutes and Strategy index exit
watch_list.why: Minutes from the Fed's October meeting are due Nov. 18, and MSCI removes Strategy from its global standard indexes after the Nov. 30 close (The Crypto Desk).

movers.name: Gram (GRAM)
movers.note: Biggest gainer among the top 90 coins, about $1.27, in the 24 hours to 11:05 a.m. ET (TokenPost).
